research.arcane_terminal.arcane_crafting: Fetching every ingredient from chests before each arcane craft is tedious work. You wonder whether the workbench could reach straight into your storage, the way those clever Crafting Terminals do.

Sprinkle Salis Mundus on a Crafting Terminal and it becomes an Arcane Crafting Terminal. It keeps its connection to your storage and gains everything an Arcane Workbench has: the crafting grid, a slot for each primal crystal and a wand slot. Ingredients used up by a craft are refilled from storage.
A button beside the terminal switches between the arcane workbench layout and the plain crafting terminal layout. Your crystals and wand stay in place while hidden.
The vis for arcane crafts is drawn from the aura around the terminal. Place an Arcane Workbench Charger on top of the network's Inventory Connector and every Arcane Crafting Terminal on that network draws vis from the 3x3 chunks around the connector.
Bind an Advanced Wireless Terminal to it to reach the arcane workbench from afar.
